name: Szubomi
bio: I make Afro-gospel music as Szubomi. I’m from the southern part of Nigeria and grew up in Lagos, and music is the creative outlet where I get to express myself in new ways. My first single, Yahweh, came to life during uneven times in my life; making it was a sign that the worst was behind me and the future ahead is bright as a new day. Yahweh II, with Charles Miles, followed a month later. More singles coming.
